question: Should OpenClaw adopt Agent Profiles as the public contract for model-specific harness behavior and proceed with this RFC’s phased registry and migration direction?
rationale: The branch intentionally proposes new configuration, schema, migration, ownership, and ClawHub distribution boundaries; source review cannot decide those product contracts without maintainer consensus.

options.title: Continue the draft lifecycle
options.body: Open the maintainer discussion, complete the author’s manual pass, resolve phase and compatibility questions, and accept the RFC only after consensus.

options.title: Narrow phase one
options.body: Limit the accepted contract to deterministic local profile selection and defer ClawHub distribution, Serving Presets, or broader model-family migration to follow-up RFCs.

options.title: Decline the direction
options.body: Close the proposal if maintainers prefer existing model-specific configuration paths over a shared Agent Profiles abstraction.

recommendation.title: Continue the draft lifecycle
recommendation.body: Open the maintainer discussion, complete the author’s manual pass, resolve phase and compatibility questions, and accept the RFC only after consensus.

likelyOwner.reason: They carried nearly every substantive schema, naming, layering, and migration revision and are best positioned to coordinate the pending lifecycle work.
